title: Main and Server
description: Study the implementation in [main.py] and [web/server.py]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include main, summary, handle, db, hash_password, verify_password, init_db, load_secret, sign; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in main.py, web/server.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
